read.thesis: CRH's FY25 Adjusted EBITDA rose 11% to $7.7bn on pricing and M&A, but growth capex still rose to $1.7bn and net debt climbed to $14.2bn; FY26 guidance implies only modest growth.

capex.quote: $1.7bn invested in high-return, low-risk growth capex projects, driving organic growth and performance improvement

triggers.label: Aggregates pricing +4% in FY25
triggers.quote: Aggregates pricing increased by 4% year-on-year, reflecting adverse mix-effects

triggers.label: Q4 Building Solutions revenue -1%
triggers.quote: Total revenues were 1% behind Q4 2024, with strong demand in the energy and communication sectors

triggers.label: Growth capex $1.7bn, rising
triggers.quote: $1.7bn invested in high-return, low-risk growth capex projects
triggers.highlight: $1.7bn invested in high-return, low-risk growth capex projects

guidance.quote: Expect further growth & value creation with FY 26 Net income of $3.9bn to $4.1bn

red_flags.label: Net debt up 35% to $14.2bn
red_flags.quote: Net Debt* as of December 31, 2025, was $14.2 billion, compared with $10.5 billion in 2024

red_flags.label: Interest expense up 32%
red_flags.quote: Interest expense for the year ended December 31, 2025, of $810 million was higher than the prior year (2024: $612 million)
